cards.name: IVGTextureFill
cards.summary: The settings of a texture fill (or of a texture transparency) on a CorelDRAW object: which procedural bitmap texture from which texture library, its tile size, origin, row/column offset, rotation, skew and mirroring, and the resolution the texture is rendered at. The result is a seamless generated bitmap pattern (stone, clouds, paper-like grain) filling the shape.
use_for: stone, paper or cloud backgrounds behind a poster headline
copy one texture fill from a sample shape to many shapes
raise the texture Resolution before a print export so the fill is not soft
texture transparency for a grungy fade on a badge or label
avoid: heavy print jobs at high Resolution: texture fills render as bitmaps and bloat file size and RIP time; use a bitmap pattern or a placed image instead
artwork that must match a supplied image exactly: use a bitmap pattern fill or PowerClip the image
cards.how: Reached through Shape.Fill.Texture once a texture fill is applied, or as the return value of Fill.ApplyTextureFill(TextureName, LibraryName); the same object sits behind Transparency.Texture and Transparency.ApplyTextureTransparency. Select swaps the texture, the tile and transform properties place it, and Properties exposes the texture's own generator parameters.

key_members.name: Select
key_members.use: switch to another texture (Texture, optional Library)

key_members.name: TileOffset
key_members.use: amount of the row / column offset

key_members.name: RotationAngle
key_members.use: rotate the texture inside the shape

key_members.name: TransformWithShape
key_members.use: texture follows when the shape is scaled / rotated

key_members.name: MirrorFillY
key_members.use: mirror tiles in the other direction

key_members.name: Resolution
key_members.use: render resolution of the generated bitmap

key_members.name: MaximumTileWidth
key_members.use: cap on the generated tile width

key_members.name: SetProperties
key_members.use: set the generator parameters from one array

gotchas: texture and library names are the strings shown in CorelDRAW's texture library list; read them from an existing fill (TextureName / LibraryName) rather than typing them, since they may be localised (unverified)
Resolution (dpi) and MaximumTileWidth (pixels) decide how sharp the generated bitmap is: low values look soft in print, high ones make files heavy (unverified)
the harvested description of MirrorFillY says 'horizontal', the same as MirrorFillX; it is most likely the vertical mirror (unverified)
LibraryName, TextureName and StyleName are read-only: change the texture with Select, not by assigning a name
SetProperties takes a SAFEARRAY of variants whose layout the harvest does not describe; set single parameters through Properties.Item(...).Value instead (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim src As TextureFill, s As Shape
Set src = ActiveSelectionRange(1).Fill.Texture
For Each s In ActiveSelectionRange
  With s.Fill.ApplyTextureFill(src.TextureName, src.LibraryName)
    .Resolution = src.Resolution: .TileWidth = src.TileWidth: .TileHeight = src.TileHeight
  End With
Next s

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGTextureFillProperties
cards.summary: The list of a texture fill's own generator parameters, i.e. the values offered when that texture is edited in the fill dialog. Each texture has its own set (numeric values and RGB, HSB or CMYK colours, as cdrTexturePropertyType tells), so this collection is how a script discovers what a given texture exposes.
use_for: find the seed parameter of a stone texture and make several variations of it
recolour a texture fill to brand colours
log a client file's texture parameters so the fill can be recreated
avoid: assuming parameter names or positions are the same for every texture: iterate first and match by name
cards.how: TextureFill.Properties (read-only), e.g. ActiveShape.Fill.Texture.Properties. A base-1 collection whose Item takes an index or the parameter's name; For Each works through _NewEnum.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of parameters this texture has

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: one parameter by index (base 1) or by name

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the parameters

gotchas: each texture has its own parameter list, so an index that is the seed on one texture is a colour or softness value on another
parameter names are display strings and may be localised (unverified)
Item with a name the texture does not have raises an error (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim p As TextureFillProperty
For Each p In ActiveShape.Fill.Texture.Properties
  If p.Type = cdrTexturePropertyNumeric Then Debug.Print p.Name, p.Value Else Debug.Print p.Name, "(colour)"
Next p

review.changes: summary: replaced the invented list of typical parameters (seed, softness, density) with the parameter kinds cdrTexturePropertyType actually defines

cards.name: IVGTextureFillProperty
cards.summary: One generator parameter of a texture fill: its display name, its kind (a number, or an RGB, HSB or CMYK colour) and its current value, which can be changed to alter the texture's pattern or colouring.
use_for: bump a texture's seed number to get a new random-looking variation
set a texture's colour parameters to brand colours
avoid: guessing which parameter is which by position: check Name and Type first
cards.how: An item of TextureFill.Properties: Properties.Item(index or name), or the loop variable of a For Each over Properties.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: numeric or an RGB / HSB / CMYK colour (cdrTexturePropertyType, read-only)

key_members.name: Value
key_members.use: read or set the parameter's value

gotchas: Value is a Variant whose content depends on Type: a number for cdrTexturePropertyNumeric; what a colour-type parameter expects (a Color object or a packed number) is not stated in the harvest (unverified)
numeric parameters have ranges the harvest does not list; out-of-range values may be clamped or rejected (unverified)
the fill may need a refresh (or the texture re-selected) before the new value shows on screen (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim p As TextureFillProperty
Set p = ActiveShape.Fill.Texture.Properties.Item(1)
Debug.Print p.Name, p.Type
If p.Type = cdrTexturePropertyNumeric Then p.Value = p.Value + 1

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGTextVariableAxes
cards.summary: The design axes a text range's font offers when it is an OpenType variable font (weight, width, slant, optical size or a custom axis). Count is the number of axes; it is 0 for an ordinary static font.
use_for: check whether a client's font is variable before relying on in-between weights
list a variable font's axes and ranges for a type spec
reach an axis to set a headline to a weight no static style has
avoid: static fonts: there are no axes; pick a different font style instead
cards.how: TextRange.VariableAxes, e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story.VariableAxes or a sub-range such as Story.Words.First.VariableAxes. Item takes a numeric index only, so find an axis by looping and checking Name or Tag.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of axes of the range's font (0 = not a variable font)

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the axes

gotchas: Item accepts only a long index, not an axis name or tag
the harvest describes Count as 'supported by the selection's font'; a range that mixes fonts may report only one font's axes or none (unverified)
the index is assumed to be base 1 like the rest of the object model (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim ax As TextVariableAxis
For Each ax In ActiveShape.Text.Story.VariableAxes
  Debug.Print ax.Name, ax.MinValue, ax.DefaultValue, ax.MaxValue
Next ax

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGTextVariableAxis
cards.summary: One axis of a variable font on a text range: its OpenType tag, its display name, the allowed minimum and maximum, the font's default, and the current Value, which can be set to dial the typeface continuously (for example a weight between Regular and Bold, or a narrower width).
use_for: fine-tune headline weight so a line fits without changing the point size
make one word heavier than the rest while keeping the same font
reset text to the font's intended default design (DefaultValue)
avoid: static fonts: they have no axes; switch font style instead
cards.how: An item of TextRange.VariableAxes (Item(i) or a For Each loop variable). Apply it to a sub-range (Words, Characters) to vary the design per word.

key_members.name: Tag
key_members.use: the OpenType axis tag as a number (read-only)

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: axis display name, e.g. a weight or width axis (read-only)

key_members.name: Value
key_members.use: read or set the axis position

key_members.name: DefaultValue
key_members.use: the font's default for this axis (read-only)

gotchas: Tag is a long, not the four-letter text such as wght or wdth; compare Name, or decode the four bytes (byte order unverified)
keep Value within MinValue..MaxValue; out-of-range values may be clamped or raise an error (unverified)
setting Value through Story.VariableAxes changes every character; take a sub-range to vary it per word
axis names come from the font file, so match them case-insensitively and expect fonts to differ (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim ax As TextVariableAxis
For Each ax In ActiveShape.Text.Story.Words.First.VariableAxes
  If LCase(ax.Name) = "weight" Then ax.Value = ax.MaxValue
Next ax

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGTextWords
cards.summary: The words of a text range as a collection: each Item returns a TextRange covering one word (or several consecutive words), and All / First / Last give ready-made ranges, so a script can read or format text word by word.
use_for: colour or bold the first word of a headline
enlarge the last word of a tagline
count words in a paragraph frame for copy-fitting
apply a style to selected words of a body text
avoid: letter-level effects (drop caps, per-letter colour): use TextRange.Characters instead
cards.how: TextRange.Words, usually ActiveShape.Text.Story.Words. Item(Index, Count) returns a TextRange starting at word Index (base 1) and spanning Count words (default 1).

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of words in the range

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: TextRange of word Index, optionally Count words long

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the words

gotchas: Item, First, Last and All return TextRange objects, not strings; read .Text for the characters
editing the text inside a loop changes the word count and indices; loop backwards or collect ranges first (unverified)
what counts as a word (punctuation, hyphens, a trailing space) follows CorelDRAW's own rules (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim w As TextWords
Set w = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Words
w.First.Bold = True
w.First.Fill.ApplyUniformFill CreateRGBColor(230, 57, 70)
w.Last.Size = w.Last.Size * 1.5
Debug.Print w.Count & " words"

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGToolShape
cards.summary: The call-back interface an add-on implements to define a custom 'tool shape': a parametric object whose geometry CorelDRAW asks the add-on to rebuild when it is created, transformed or restyled. Its only member, OnGenerateShape, receives the target layer, the shape's stored properties, its style and its transformation, and must draw the result.
use_for: a parametric object for a house design system, e.g. a price badge that redraws from stored settings
smart shapes that keep their construction rules when the user resizes them
avoid: one-off artwork: draw it directly with the Layer.Create* methods
files that must open correctly on machines without the add-on: the shape depends on its registered generator (unverified)
cards.how: Not reached from the object model: you write a class that implements IVGToolShape, register it once per session with Application.RegisterToolShape(ToolShapeGuid, ToolShapeAttributes, ToolShape), then create instances with Layer.CreateToolShape(ToolShapeGuid, ShapeProperties). CorelDRAW then calls OnGenerateShape(Parent, ObjectProperties, pStyleAttributes, pTransformation, IsPreviewOnly) whenever it needs the geometry.

key_members.name: OnGenerateShape
key_members.use: called by CorelDRAW to build the shape on Parent from ObjectProperties, the style and the transformation

gotchas: OnGenerateShape is called by CorelDRAW, never by your own code; build the geometry on Parent (an IVGLayer) from the values stored in ObjectProperties
IsPreviewOnly is True during interactive previews, so keep that path cheap (unverified)
registration lasts only for the running session, so it has to happen at start-up (a GMS module or add-on) (unverified)
whether a VBA class module can implement this interface or a compiled add-on (VSTA / C++) is needed is not stated in the harvest (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim attr As ToolShapeAttributes, props As Properties
Set attr = CreateToolShapeAttributes
attr.SetCanRotate True: attr.SetRegenerateOnTransform True
RegisterToolShape "{0D2F6A31-7C1B-4E7A-9B3E-1F2A3B4C5D6E}", attr, New MyBadgeShape  ' class that Implements IVGToolShape
Set props = CreateProperties
ActiveLayer.CreateToolShape "{0D2F6A31-7C1B-4E7A-9B3E-1F2A3B4C5D6E}", props

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGToolShapeAttributes
cards.summary: The behaviour switches for a custom tool shape type, set once when it is registered: whether instances may be resized, rotated, skewed, stretched disproportionately or envelope-distorted, whether CorelDRAW regenerates the geometry after a transform or a style change, and which property bar, context menu, Objects-docker icon, edit state and default object name it uses.
use_for: let a parametric badge scale and rotate but never skew
make a smart shape redraw itself when resized instead of stretching
give a custom shape its own property bar and default object name
avoid: ordinary scripted artwork: these settings only matter for registered tool shapes
cards.how: Created with Application.CreateToolShapeAttributes, filled with the Set* methods, then passed to Application.RegisterToolShape together with the IVGToolShape implementation.

key_members.name: SetRegenerateOnTransform
key_members.use: call the generator again after a resize

key_members.name: SetRegenerateOnStyleChange
key_members.use: call the generator again after a style change

key_members.name: SetPropertyBarGuid
key_members.use: property bar shown for the shape

key_members.name: SetEditStateGuid
key_members.use: tool state used to edit the shape

key_members.name: SetDefaultShapename
key_members.use: default object name of new instances

gotchas: every member is a write-only Set* method; nothing reads the settings back
the attributes are taken when RegisterToolShape runs; changing them later probably does not affect the registered type (unverified)
the GUID setters expect GUIDs of UI items (property bar, context menu, edit state) defined by the add-on's own UI configuration (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim attr As ToolShapeAttributes
Set attr = CreateToolShapeAttributes
attr.SetCanResize True: attr.SetCanRotate True
attr.SetCanSkew False: attr.SetCanApplyNonlinearTransforms False
attr.SetRegenerateOnTransform True
attr.SetDefaultShapename "Price Badge"
RegisterToolShape "{0D2F6A31-7C1B-4E7A-9B3E-1F2A3B4C5D6E}", attr, New MyBadgeShape

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGToolState
cards.summary: The call-back interface of a custom interactive tool: CorelDRAW calls its On* methods as the user moves the mouse, clicks, drags, double-clicks, presses keys, commits with Enter, aborts with Esc or when a timer fires, so an add-on can implement its own drawing or editing tool on the canvas.
use_for: a click-to-place tool, e.g. stamp a numbered marker where the user clicks
a measuring or guide tool that previews with on-screen curves while dragging
a custom two-click connector or callout tool
avoid: unattended batch jobs: a tool state only acts while a person drives the mouse
jobs a plain macro over the current selection can do
cards.how: Write a class that implements IVGToolState, register it with Application.RegisterToolState(ToolStateGuid, ToolStateName, ToolState), and activate it by setting Application.ActiveToolStateGuid to that GUID (or Application.StartTemporaryToolState for a temporary state). OnStartState hands over the IVGToolStateAttributes object that sets the cursor, snapping and timers.

key_members.name: OnStartState
key_members.use: tool activated; receives the StateAttributes object

key_members.name: OnExitState
key_members.use: tool deactivated: clean up previews and timers

key_members.name: OnLButtonDownLeaveGrace
key_members.use: button held and the mouse moved: a drag has started

key_members.name: OnClick
key_members.use: a click, with a Handled flag

key_members.name: OnRButtonDown
key_members.use: right button pressed, with a Handled flag

key_members.name: OnKeyDown
key_members.use: key pressed (KeyCode), with a Handled flag

key_members.name: OnSnapMouse
key_members.use: chance to set the snapped position before a move

key_members.name: OnTimer
key_members.use: a timer started with StartTimer fired

key_members.name: IsDrawing
key_members.use: tell CorelDRAW the tool is mid-gesture

gotchas: the methods with a Handled argument (OnClick, OnRButtonDown/Up, OnKeyDown/Up, OnDelete, OnSnapMouse) let the tool claim the event; leaving Handled False lets CorelDRAW's default behaviour run (unverified)
keep the StateAttributes object from OnStartState in a class-level variable; the other call-backs do not receive it
a VBA class that Implements the interface must define every On* member and IsDrawing, even as empty procedures
pt arrives as a point in document coordinates, usable directly with Layer.Create* calls (unverified)
whether a VBA class can implement it or a compiled add-on is needed is not stated in the harvest (unverified)
cards.example:
Implements IVGToolState   ' class module MarkerTool (other members omitted)
Private attrs As IVGToolStateAttributes
Private Sub IVGToolState_OnStartState(ByVal StateAttributes As IVGToolStateAttributes)
  Set attrs = StateAttributes: attrs.SetCursor cdrCursorSmallcrosshair
End Sub
Private Sub IVGToolState_OnLButtonUp(ByVal pt As IVGPoint)
  attrs.Document.ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2 pt.x, pt.y, 2
End Sub

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGToolStateAttributes
cards.summary: The control object CorelDRAW hands a custom tool state when it starts: it sets the tool's cursor, property bar, context menu, status-bar text and hints page, switches behaviours (tablet pressure, temporary pick tool, auto-pan, deselect on click), runs timers, snaps or constrains mouse positions, reports key and pen-pressure state, and captures or releases the mouse.
use_for: show live coordinates or measurements in the status bar while a custom tool drags
snap a custom tool's clicks to nodes, grid and guides like the built-in tools
Shift-constrained angles in a custom drawing tool
pressure-sensitive custom brush tools on a tablet
avoid: anything outside a running custom tool: the object only exists inside a tool state
cards.how: Only received as the StateAttributes argument of IVGToolState.OnStartState; store it in the tool class and use it from the other call-backs.

key_members.name: PropertyBarGuid
key_members.use: property bar shown with the tool

key_members.name: SetStateHintsPage
key_members.use: hints page path for the tool

key_members.name: CurrentPressure
key_members.use: current pen pressure (1.0 when pressure is off)

key_members.name: DeselectOnLButtonDown
key_members.use: clear the selection on mouse down

key_members.name: SnapMouse
key_members.use: snap a point like the built-in tools

key_members.name: AnchoredSnapMouse
key_members.use: snap relative to an anchor point

key_members.name: ConstrainMouse
key_members.use: constrain a point (angle / axis) from an anchor

key_members.name: StartTimer
key_members.use: start a timer that fires OnTimer

key_members.name: Document
key_members.use: the document the tool works on

key_members.name: CaptureMouse
key_members.use: route mouse input to the tool

gotchas: valid only inside a running tool state; it arrives in IVGToolState.OnStartState and should be stored there
SnapMouse, AnchoredSnapMouse and ConstrainMouse adjust the point you pass in place rather than returning a new one (unverified)
CurrentPressure is 1.0 whenever UseTabletPressure is False, so turn that on before reading pressure
a timer from StartTimer keeps firing OnTimer until StopTimer unless OneTime was True; stop timers in OnExitState (unverified)
ExitTemporaryToolState only applies to a state started with Application.StartTemporaryToolState
cards.example:
Private Sub IVGToolState_OnMouseMove(ByVal pt As IVGPoint)   ' attrs stored in OnStartState
  attrs.SnapMouse pt
  attrs.StatusInfo = "x=" & Format(pt.x, "0.00") & "  y=" & Format(pt.y, "0.00")
  If attrs.IsKeyDown(vbKeyShift) Then attrs.SetCursor cdrCursorWinCross Else attrs.SetCursor cdrCursorSmallcrosshair
End Sub

review.changes: example: replaced the bare key code 16 (not in the harvest) with the VBA constant vbKeyShift

cards.name: IVGTraceSettings
cards.summary: A PowerTRACE session started on a bitmap: it holds the trace mode (line art, logo, detailed logo, clipart, low or high quality image, technical, line drawing), smoothing, detail level, corner smoothness, colour mode, palette and colour count, background removal and the merge / group / overlap options, previews how many curves and nodes the trace will produce, and Finish turns the bitmap into vector shapes.
use_for: vectorise a client's low-resolution logo into clean curves
batch-trace scanned line art for cutting, engraving or embroidery prep
turn a photo into a posterised vector illustration with a fixed number of colours
reject a trace whose node count is too high before committing it
avoid: photos that must stay photographic: keep the bitmap
tiny or noisy bitmaps: resample or clean them first or the trace explodes into thousands of nodes
unattended runs that call ShowDialog: it is modal and waits for a person
cards.how: Returned by Shape.Bitmap.Trace(TraceType, Smoothing, DetailLevelPercent, ColorMode, PaletteID, ColorCount, DeleteOriginalObject, RemoveBackground, RemoveEntireBackColor) on a bitmap shape. Change settings, call ApplyChanges to recompute, read the counts, then Finish returns the traced shapes as a ShapeRange.

key_members.name: DetailLevelPercent
key_members.use: detail as a percentage of the maximum

key_members.name: SetColorMode
key_members.use: colour model of the result (resets the palette)

key_members.name: SetColorCount
key_members.use: number of colours in the result

key_members.name: BackgroundRemovalMode
key_members.use: detect the background automatically or manually

key_members.name: RemoveEntireBackColor
key_members.use: remove that colour everywhere, not just the background

key_members.name: MergeAdjacentObjects
key_members.use: merge touching areas of the same colour

key_members.name: RemoveOverlap
key_members.use: cut stacked shapes so they do not overlap

key_members.name: ApplyChanges
key_members.use: recompute the trace after changing settings

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: create the vectors and return them as a ShapeRange

gotchas: no vectors exist until Finish; dropping the object leaves the bitmap untouched (unverified)
call ApplyChanges after changing settings before reading CurveCount, NodeCount or ColorCount, or they describe the old settings (unverified)
ColorMode and PaletteID are read-only: use SetColorMode (which also resets the generated palette), then SetColorCount
BackgroundColor is read-only; with BackgroundRemovalMode set to manual the colour has to be picked in ShowDialog (unverified)
DetailLevel is absolute and only valid between MinDetailLevel and MaxDetailLevel; DetailLevelPercent is the safer control
Shape.Bitmap only exists on bitmap shapes; on a vector it fails (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim ts As TraceSettings, sr As ShapeRange
Set ts = ActiveShape.Bitmap.Trace(cdrTraceLogo, , 70, cdrColorRGB, , 6)
ts.RemoveBackground = True
ts.MergeAdjacentObjects = True
ts.ApplyChanges
Debug.Print ts.CurveCount & " curves, " & ts.NodeCount & " nodes"
Set sr = ts.Finish

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGTransformMatrix
cards.summary: A 2D affine transformation (the 2x2 part d11, d12, d21, d22 plus an x/y translation) that can be built up by translating, rotating, scaling and combining, inverted, tested (identity, mirrored, rotated ...), used to transform points and vectors, and applied to shapes.
use_for: rotate and scale many copies around a common centre for rosettes and radial badges
map artwork from one line segment onto another (Math.CreateLineSegmentTransformMatrix)
mirror a shape about an arbitrary point
check whether a placed logo in a client file was mirrored or skewed (IsMirrored, IsSkewedOrRotated)
avoid: simple moves and rotations of one shape: Shape.Move / Shape.Rotate are clearer
cards.how: Created by Document.Math or Application.Math (CreateIdentityTransformMatrix, CreateRotationTransformMatrix, CreateScaleTransformMatrix, CreateTranslationTransformMatrix, CreateLineSegmentTransformMatrix), or read from Shape.TransformationMatrix. Apply it with Shape.ApplyTransformMatrix or Curve.ApplyTransformMatrix.

key_members.name: RotateAround
key_members.use: add a rotation about a point

key_members.name: ScaleAround
key_members.use: add a scale about a point

key_members.name: UntransformPoint
key_members.use: apply the inverse to a point

gotchas: an unbound matrix uses CorelDRAW's internal coordinates; BindToDocument makes it use the document's units and origin. Matrices made by Document.Math are probably bound already (unverified)
Rotate, Scale, TranslateBy, Transform and Invert change the matrix in place; take GetCopy first to keep the original
angles are in degrees, counter-clockwise like IVGVector.Angle (unverified)
whether Transform pre- or post-multiplies is not stated in the harvest; test with TransformPoint on a known point (unverified)
Shape.TransformationMatrix can read as identity on curves because their transforms are baked into the nodes (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim m As TransformMatrix, s As Shape
Set s = ActiveShape
Set m = ActiveDocument.Math.CreateIdentityTransformMatrix
m.ScaleAround 1.2, 1.2, s.CenterX, s.CenterY
m.RotateAround 15, s.CenterX, s.CenterY
s.ApplyTransformMatrix m

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGTransparency
cards.summary: The transparency applied to a CorelDRAW object: none, uniform, fountain (gradient), pattern or texture, with its start and end amounts, whether it affects the fill, the outline or both, the merge mode (Multiply, Screen, Overlay and the other blend modes), and freezing, which bakes the objects underneath into a static snapshot.
use_for: fade a photo or shape into the background with a gradient on a poster
Multiply overlays for soft shadows and colour washes
a 50% tint panel behind headline text
find and remove transparency before a file goes to a printer that cannot handle it
avoid: print RIPs that flatten transparency badly: flatten or convert to bitmap first
when only a lighter colour is needed: use a tint of the colour instead of transparency
cards.how: Shape.Transparency on any shape. Type tells what is applied; the Apply* methods set the kind and return the Fountain / Pattern / Texture fill object for fine-tuning; AppliedTo and MergeMode then refine it.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: what kind of transparency is applied (read-only)

key_members.name: ApplyUniformTransparency
key_members.use: flat transparency of a given amount

key_members.name: Freeze
key_members.use: bake what is underneath into the object

gotchas: the numbers are transparency amounts, not opacity: 0 is fully opaque and 100 fully transparent (the harvest only gives Start 0 / End 100 as defaults) (unverified)
Type is read-only; change the kind with the Apply* methods
Freeze turns it into a snapshot of the objects underneath; moving things later will not update it until Unfreeze (unverified)
MergeMode uses CorelDRAW's own merge-mode list (cdrMergeMultiply, cdrMergeScreen, cdrMergeOverlay ...), not Photoshop's list or order
UserAssign opens a modal dialog; keep it out of unattended runs
some export filters rasterise or flatten transparent objects (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
Set s = ActiveShape
s.Transparency.ApplyFountainTransparency 0, 100, cdrLinearFountainFill, 90
s.Transparency.AppliedTo = cdrApplyToFill
s.Transparency.MergeMode = cdrMergeMultiply

review.changes: gotchas: marked the 0 = opaque / 100 = transparent reading and the Freeze snapshot behaviour as unverified (the harvest gives only the 0 / 100 defaults and "Freezes the transparency")

cards.name: IVGTreeManager
cards.summary: Document-level entry to CorelDRAW's object tree (the structure the Objects docker shows): reports how many tree nodes are selected and the first of them, creates unlinked group nodes, tidies empty or single-child groups, and provides a virtual layer for building shapes that are not yet part of the document.
use_for: build a large generated layout off-document and link it in one step
walk the current selection in tree order (FirstSelectedNode, then TreeNode.NextSelected)
clean up groups left empty or with one object after a batch edit
avoid: simple scripts: ActiveSelectionRange and Layer.Shapes are easier and safer
cards.how: ActiveDocument.TreeManager or Application.ActiveTreeManager. Shapes made on VirtualLayer and nodes from CreateGroupNode are unlinked; place them with TreeNode.LinkAsChildOf, LinkBefore or LinkAfter.

key_members.name: VirtualLayer
key_members.use: a layer for creating unlinked virtual shapes

key_members.name: CleanGroupNode
key_members.use: remove an empty group or unwrap a one-child group

gotchas: shapes made on VirtualLayer do not appear in the document until their TreeNode is linked under a layer or group node (unverified)
unlinked nodes that are never linked are lost when the script ends (unverified)
CleanGroupNode returns a TreeNode, probably the surviving node (the single child when a one-child group is removed); keep the return value (unverified)
SelectedNodeCount counts tree nodes, which can differ from ActiveSelectionRange.Count when groups or their children are selected (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim tm As TreeManager, g As TreeNode, s As Shape
Set tm = ActiveDocument.TreeManager
Set g = tm.CreateGroupNode
Set s = tm.VirtualLayer.CreateRectangle2(0, 0, 50, 30)
s.TreeNode.LinkAsChildOf g
g.LinkAsChildOf ActiveLayer.TreeNode

review.changes: gotchas: CleanGroupNode return-value claim marked unverified (harvest only says it eliminates empty / one-child groups and returns a TreeNode)

cards.name: IVGTreeNode
cards.summary: One node of a CorelDRAW document's object tree: the root, a page, a layer, a group or link group, a symbol or a shape. It walks the tree (parent, children, siblings, the selection chain), unlinks, relinks and reorders nodes, copies or swaps their data, renames and deletes them, and gives the Shape, Page, Layer and Document it belongs to.
use_for: fast audit of every object in a multi-page brochure (names, types) without selecting anything
reorder objects in the stack by name (MoveToFirst / MoveToLast)
rename objects for an export or data-merge pipeline
move objects between groups or layers without cut and paste
avoid: everyday edits of the selection: Shape and ShapeRange methods are simpler
cards.how: Document.TreeRoot, Page.TreeNode, Layer.TreeNode, Shape.TreeNode, Spread.TreeNode or TreeManager.FirstSelectedNode; then walk with FirstChild / Next or the Children collection.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: root, page, layer, group, link group, symbol or shape node (cdrTreeNodeType)

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: read or set the node's name

key_members.name: Shape
key_members.use: the real shape this node represents

key_members.name: NextSelected
key_members.use: next node in the selection chain

key_members.name: UnLink
key_members.use: detach the node from the tree

key_members.name: LinkAsChildOf
key_members.use: insert as the first child of a node

key_members.name: MoveToFirst
key_members.use: move to the start of its siblings

key_members.name: MoveToLast
key_members.use: move to the end of its siblings

gotchas: Shape is only meaningful on shape and group nodes; for root, page and layer nodes use Page or Layer (unverified)
UnLink detaches without destroying: relink the node or call Delete
Delete destroys the node physically and may not behave like an undoable Shape.Delete (unverified)
which end of the sibling list is the top of the stack is not stated in the harvest (unverified)
GetCopy makes a temporary unlinked copy; link it somewhere to keep it
cards.example:
Sub Dump(n As TreeNode, d As Long)  ' call: Dump ActiveDocument.TreeRoot, 0
  Dim c As TreeNode
  Debug.Print String(d * 2, " ") & n.Type & " " & n.Name
  Set c = n.FirstChild
  Do While Not c Is Nothing: Dump c, d + 1: Set c = c.Next: Loop
End Sub

review.changes: summary and Type key member: added the link-group node type (cdrLinkGroupNode) that the enum lists

cards.name: IVGTreeNodes
cards.summary: The direct children of one object-tree node (the layers of a page, the objects on a layer, the members of a group) as a countable, enumerable collection.
use_for: list what is directly inside a group or on a layer
count objects per layer for a preflight report
avoid: deep walks: recurse with FirstChild / Next, since this only holds one level
cards.how: TreeNode.Children, e.g. ActivePage.TreeNode.Children or Shape.TreeNode.Children.

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the children

gotchas: linking, unlinking or moving nodes while looping over the collection can skip or repeat nodes (unverified)
Item takes a numeric index only, assumed base 1 (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim n As TreeNode
For Each n In ActivePage.TreeNode.Children
  Debug.Print n.Type, n.Name, n.Children.Count
Next n

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGURL
cards.summary: The internet link attached to an object: the address, target frame, alternate (ALT) text, bookmark name, and whether the clickable hot-spot is the object's bounding rectangle or its exact shape. It becomes a clickable link when the design is published to PDF or HTML.
use_for: clickable website, WhatsApp or email links on an interactive PDF brochure or e-catalogue
bookmarks for a PDF's navigation
set the same link on every button or logo in a document in one pass
avoid: print-only output: links have no effect on paper
cards.how: Shape.URL on any shape.

key_members.name: TargetFrame
key_members.use: frame / window the link opens in

key_members.name: Region
key_members.use: hot-spot: default, bounding rectangle or exact shape (cdrURLRegion)

gotchas: whether links survive depends on the export filter's settings (e.g. PDF hyperlink options) (unverified)
clearing Address removes the link (unverified)
Region cdrURLRegionShape makes only the exact outline clickable; cdrURLRegionRectangle uses the bounding box
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActiveSelectionRange
  s.URL.Address = "https://example.com/shop"
  s.URL.AltComment = "Shop now"
  s.URL.Region = cdrURLRegionShape
Next s

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGUserSnapPoint
cards.summary: The extra settings of a user-defined snap point (a custom point added to a shape that snapping and connector lines can latch onto): its unique ID and whether connectors attach to it automatically.
use_for: add connection points to flowchart or diagram symbols so connector lines attach to fixed spots

avoid: ordinary snapping to nodes, centres or edges: those snap points already exist

key_members.name: AutoSnap
key_members.use: include it when connectors snap automatically

gotchas: SnapPoint.User only applies when the snap point's Type is cdrSnapPointUser; for other types it is empty or fails (unverified)
ID is read-only: to pick your own ID use SnapPoints.AddUserSnapPointEx
position, direction and deletion live on the SnapPoint object, not here
cards.example:
Dim sp As SnapPoint, s As Shape
Set s = ActiveShape
Set sp = s.SnapPoints.AddUserSnapPoint(s.CenterX, s.CenterY + s.SizeHeight / 2)
sp.User.AutoSnap = True

cards.name: IVGVariableWidthNode
cards.summary: One width node of a variable-width outline: its position along the path (0 to 1), the total stroke width there and the separate widths on each side of the path, plus whether it is selected and a Delete.
use_for: make a stroke swell on one side only (Side1Width / Side2Width)
move or thicken the widest point of a brush-like stroke
avoid: uniform outlines: just set Outline.Width
cards.how: An item of Outline.VariableWidthNodes (Item(i)) or the return value of VariableWidthNodes.Add(t, Width). The harvest's description calls it 'the main interface for Nodes class', but its members are the width-node ones.

key_members.name: Width
key_members.use: total stroke width at this node

key_members.name: Side1Width
key_members.use: width on side 1 of the path

key_members.name: Side2Width
key_members.use: width on side 2 of the path

gotchas: Delete (and Add on the collection) invalidates node objects at or after this position; fetch them again from VariableWidthNodes
which side is 1 and which is 2 follows the path direction (unverified)
the harvest does not state the width units; document units are likely (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim i As Long, vw As IVGVariableWidthNodes
Set vw = ActiveShape.Outline.VariableWidthNodes
For i = 1 To vw.Count
  vw.Item(i).Side2Width = 0
  Debug.Print vw.Item(i).PositionT, vw.Item(i).Width
Next i

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGVariableWidthNodes
cards.summary: The width nodes of a variable-width outline, as made with the Variable Outline tool: each node sets the stroke thickness at a position along the path, so a line can swell and taper like a brush or calligraphic stroke. The collection can be read, extended at a 0-1 position, cleared or copied from another outline.
use_for: tapered, hand-drawn-looking strokes for illustrations and icons
the same calligraphic swell on every curve of a sketched logo
copy one stroke profile to many curves (Copy)
avoid: outputs that do not understand variable outlines (some cutters and exports): convert the outline to an object first (unverified)
cards.how: Outline.VariableWidthNodes, e.g. ActiveShape.Outline.VariableWidthNodes. No VBA class name is harvested for it, so declare variables As IVGVariableWidthNodes.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of width nodes (0 = not a variable outline)

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: add a node at position t (0..1) with a width

key_members.name: Copy
key_members.use: take the width profile of another outline

gotchas: t must be within 0..1 along the path
Add invalidates node objects after the new node; fetch nodes again afterwards
Count is 0 when the outline is not variable; adding nodes probably turns it into one (unverified)
the shape needs an outline; the width units are not stated in the harvest (unverified)
Outline.VariableWidthNodes is Nothing (null) on objects that do not support variable outlines, and empty (Count 0) on ones that only lack one; test Is Nothing before using it
cards.example:
Dim vw As IVGVariableWidthNodes
Set vw = ActiveShape.Outline.VariableWidthNodes
If Not vw Is Nothing Then
  vw.Clear
  vw.Add 0, 0.2
  vw.Add 0.5, 3
  vw.Add 1, 0.2
End If

review.changes: added the harvested gotcha that Outline.VariableWidthNodes is null on objects without variable-outline support; example now guards with Is Nothing

cards.name: IVGVector
cards.summary: A 2D direction-and-length value for geometry scripts: x and y, length and angle, vector arithmetic (add, subtract, scale, negate, normalise), dot and cross products, angles between vectors, projection, and building one from two points.
use_for: step-and-repeat copies along an angle
orient ticks or arrows perpendicular to a path (Segment.GetPerpendicularVectorAt)
measure the angle between two lines in a technical drawing
offset a point a set distance in a direction
avoid: plain moves: Shape.Move with dx, dy is simpler
cards.how: Document.Math.CreateVector(x, y) or Application.Math.CreateVector; also returned by Segment / SubPath GetTangentVectorAt and GetPerpendicularVectorAt, and TransformMatrix.Translation.

key_members.name: Angle
key_members.use: read or set the direction in degrees, counter-clockwise from the x axis

key_members.name: SetFromPoints
key_members.use: vector from a start to an end point

key_members.name: GetOffsettedPoint
key_members.use: a point offset from an origin along the vector

gotchas: Add, Subtract, MultiplyBy, Negate and Normalize change the vector in place and return nothing; GetCopy first to keep the original
Angle is in degrees counter-clockwise from the x axis; that this means y pointing up on the page is not stated in the harvest (unverified)
a vector not bound to a document uses internal coordinates; BindToDocument (or creating it from Document.Math) makes x / y follow the document's units (unverified)
Normalize on a zero-length vector has no direction; check Length first (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim m As MathUtils, v As Vector, s As Shape
Set m = ActiveDocument.Math
Set s = ActiveShape
Set v = m.CreateVector(1, 0)
v.Angle = 30: v.Length = 40
s.Duplicate v.x, v.y
Debug.Print v.AngleBetween(m.CreateVector(0, 1))

review.changes: gotchas: the y-up coordinate claim is now marked unverified

cards.name: IVGView
cards.summary: A saved, named view of a document (as listed in the View Manager docker): a zoom level, a view origin and optionally a page, which Activate jumps back to.
use_for: bookmark detail areas of a large poster or packaging die-line for proofing
QC macros that zoom to fixed regions before taking screenshots
jump between pages and zooms during a client review
avoid: one-off zooming in a script: use ActiveWindow.ActiveView (ToFitPage, SetViewPoint) directly
cards.how: ActiveDocument.Views(index or name), the return of Document.CreateView(Name, OriginX, OriginY, Zoom, Page), or Views.AddActiveView(Name) to save the current view.

key_members.name: UseZoom
key_members.use: restore the stored zoom on Activate

key_members.name: UsePage
key_members.use: switch to the stored page on Activate

gotchas: Document.CreateView takes Zoom as a long zoom percentage (per its harvested description) while View.Zoom is a double; that View.Zoom is the same percentage is (unverified)
with UseZoom or UsePage False, Activate keeps the current zoom or page (unverified)
whether OriginX / OriginY mark the centre or a corner of the view is not stated in the harvest (unverified)

cards.example:
Dim v As View
Set v = ActiveDocument.CreateView("Logo detail", 50, 250, 400, ActivePage)
ActiveDocument.Views.AddActiveView "Whole page"
v.Activate
Debug.Print v.Name, v.Zoom, v.UsePage

cards.name: IVGViews
cards.summary: The saved views of a document (the View Manager list) as a collection: look up a view by index or name, count them, and save the current window view under a new name.
use_for: list the saved views of a client file before a review

avoid: creating a view at an exact origin and zoom: use Document.CreateView

key_members.name: Item

key_members.name: AddActiveView
key_members.use: save the active window's view under a name

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the views

Dim v As View

cards.name: IVGWindow
cards.summary: A document window in CorelDRAW: activate, close, maximise or size it, open a second window on the same document, refresh it, reach its live view (zoom and pan) and its document, and convert between screen pixels and document coordinates.
use_for: put the document in a known window state and zoom before screenshot-based QC
convert a mouse position to page coordinates in a custom tool
refresh the window after a batch of edits
open a second window to compare two parts of a large layout
avoid: setting zoom through the window size: use ActiveView instead
cards.how: ActiveWindow (Application.ActiveWindow), Document.ActiveWindow, Application.Windows(i) or Document.Windows(i).

key_members.name: Activate
key_members.use: bring the window to the front

key_members.name: ActiveView
key_members.use: the live view: zoom and pan

key_members.name: NewWindow

key_members.name: Handle
key_members.use: the window handle for Windows API calls

Left, Top, Width and Height are pixels of the document window inside CorelDRAW's frame (unverified)

after NewWindow, Document.Windows has more than one entry for the same file
FullScreen is the full-screen preview; set it back to False before further UI automation (unverified)

Dim w As Window, xd As Double, yd As Double
Set w = ActiveWindow
w.WindowState = cdrWindowMaximized
w.ActiveView.ToFitPage
w.ScreenToDocument 400, 300, xd, yd
Debug.Print w.Caption, xd, yd, w.ScreenDistanceToDocumentDistance(10)

cards.name: IVGWindows
cards.summary: A collection of document windows, either all of CorelDRAW's (Application.Windows) or one document's (Document.Windows), with lookup by index or caption, tile / cascade arrangement, refresh and close-all.
use_for: tile two documents side by side for a before / after check

key_members.use: lets For Each walk the windows

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: application or document that owns the list

Dim w As Window

Application.Windows.Arrange cdrTileVertically

cards.name: IVGWorkspace
cards.summary: One of CorelDRAW's saved user-interface workspaces (the arrangement of toolbars, dockers, menus and shortcuts, as listed under Window > Workspace): its name, description, whether it is the default and whether it is active, and Activate to switch to it.
use_for: switch to a known workspace before screenshot- or UI-driven automation so controls are where the script expects them

avoid: silently changing a person's workspace mid-session: it rearranges the whole interface

Dim ws As Workspace

Next ws
If Not ws Is Nothing Then

End If

import a file onto a chosen layer

key_members.name: CreateRectangle2

key_members.name: Import

cards.name: LocalizableString
cards.summary: The LocalizableString class: a text value that can hold one string per language plus a default, used for multilingual metadata such as document or fill titles, keywords, notes, subject and copyright.

cards.name: MathUtils
cards.summary: The MathUtils class: CorelDRAW's geometry helper. It creates points, vectors, point ranges and transformation matrices (identity, rotation, scale, translation, segment-to-segment), intersects lines, finds distances and closest points, interpolates, fits a line to points and returns random numbers.
use_for: radial repeats: rotate copies around a centre with CreateRotationTransformMatrix
snap a label to the closest point on a line
random scatter of confetti or particles (GetRandomReal)

avoid: simple moves and rotations of one shape: Shape.Move / Shape.Rotate are clearer

key_members.name: Interpolate
key_members.use: point at t between two points

Dim m As MathUtils, s As Shape, i As Long
Set m = ActiveDocument.Math
Set s = ActiveShape
For i = 1 To 5
  s.Duplicate.ApplyTransformMatrix m.CreateRotationTransformMatrix(i * 60, s.CenterX, s.CenterY)
Next i

key_members.use: first or last node of an open subpath

gotchas: only curves have nodes; rectangles, ellipses and text need ConvertToCurves first
Delete, BreakApart, joins and Fillet / Chamfer / Scallop change the node list; do not edit structure inside a For Each over Nodes, re-read Nodes after each edit or use a NodeRange
Fillet, Chamfer and Scallop return False when the node is not a corner they can modify (unverified)
positions follow the document's Unit and origin
cards.example:
Dim n As Node
Set n = ActiveShape.Curve.Nodes.Last
n.SetPosition 100, 50
Set n = ActiveShape.Curve.Nodes(1)
If n.Type = cdrCuspNode And Not n.IsEnding Then Debug.Print "filleted: " & n.Fillet(2)

review.changes: example: no longer fillets inside a For Each over the node list it is changing (contradicted its own gotcha); now moves one node and fillets one node; gotcha extended to Fillet / Chamfer / Scallop

cards.name: NodeRange
cards.summary: The NodeRange class: a set of nodes on one curve that can be edited together: moved, stretched, rotated or skewed as a unit, smoothed or auto-reduced, given one node type, filleted, chamfered or scalloped, broken apart, deleted, and turned into or added to the node selection.
use_for: clean up a trace by auto-reducing excess nodes
round every corner of a shape in one call (Fillet)
make all nodes smooth or cusp at once (SetType)
scale or rotate part of a path without touching the rest
avoid: whole-shape transforms: transform the Shape instead
cards.how: Coclass whose members are on IVGNodeRange. Reached through Shape.Curve.Nodes.All, Nodes.Range(IndexArray), Nodes.AllExcluding, Curve.Selection (the selected nodes) or Application.CreateNodeRange (empty, then Add nodes).

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of nodes in the range

key_members.name: Remove
key_members.use: remove a node from the range

key_members.name: Move
key_members.use: move all nodes by a delta

key_members.name: Stretch
key_members.use: scale the nodes as a unit

key_members.name: Rotate
key_members.use: rotate the nodes as a unit

key_members.name: Skew
key_members.use: skew the nodes as a unit

key_members.name: AutoReduce
key_members.use: remove nodes within a precision margin

key_members.name: Smoothen
key_members.use: smooth the curve at the nodes

key_members.name: BreakApart
key_members.use: break the curve at each node

gotchas: a range only holds nodes of one curve; Add with a node from another shape fails (unverified)
Delete, BreakApart and AutoReduce (which deletes nodes) change the curve, after which the range and earlier Node objects are stale; build a fresh range
AutoReduce's PrecisionMargin is in document units; too large a value distorts the shape (unverified)
Remove takes an index within the range, not a Node object
cards.example:
Dim nr As NodeRange
ActiveShape.Curve.Nodes.All.AutoReduce 0.05
Set nr = ActiveShape.Curve.Nodes.All
nr.SetType cdrSmoothNode
Debug.Print nr.Count & " nodes left"

review.changes: example: re-reads Nodes.All after AutoReduce instead of using the stale range for SetType / Count; gotcha now includes AutoReduce

cards.name: Nodes
cards.summary: The Nodes class: all nodes of a curve (or subpath) as a collection, with item lookup, count, first and last, and helpers that build NodeRanges from all, some or all-but-some of the nodes.
use_for: count nodes to flag over-complex traced artwork
loop over every node of a path
build a NodeRange of all nodes for a bulk edit
avoid: bulk edits node by node: build a NodeRange (All / Range) and edit it once
cards.how: Coclass whose members are on IVGNodes. Reached through Shape.Curve.Nodes or SubPath.Nodes.

key_members.name: AllExcluding
key_members.use: NodeRange of all but the given indices

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the nodes

gotchas: indices run across the whole curve, through every subpath (unverified)
deleting or adding nodes while looping renumbers them; collect a NodeRange first
Range and AllExcluding take an array of indices, not Node objects
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActiveSelectionRange
  If s.Type = cdrCurveShape Then
    If s.Curve.Nodes.Count > 500 Then Debug.Print s.Name & ": " & s.Curve.Nodes.Count & " nodes"
  End If
Next s

review.changes: none

cards.name: ObjectSnapPoint
cards.summary: The ObjectSnapPoint class: the extra information of an 'object' type snap point, which only says whether it is the object's top, bottom, left or right point. What CorelDRAW counts as an object snap point (as opposed to node, bounding-box or edge points) is not described in the harvest, so treat this as a low-certainty description.
use_for: read which side an object snap point sits on when aligning or connecting objects by script
avoid: general snapping: use the SnapPoint position members, which apply to every snap point type
cards.how: Coclass whose members are on IVGObjectSnapPoint. Reached as SnapPoint.Object when SnapPoint.Type is cdrSnapPointObject, e.g. from Shape.SnapPointsOfType(cdrSnapPointObject).
gotchas: SnapPoint.Object only applies to snap points of type cdrSnapPointObject; for others it is empty or fails (unverified)
the position, deletion and selection of the point are on the SnapPoint, not here
cards.example:
Dim sp As SnapPoint
For Each sp In ActiveShape.SnapPointsOfType(cdrSnapPointObject)
  Debug.Print sp.Object.Type, sp.PositionX, sp.PositionY
Next sp

review.changes: none

cards.name: OLE
cards.summary: The OLE class: an embedded or linked OLE object placed in a drawing (for example a spreadsheet table or chart): its class and program IDs, type (linked, embedded, static), names and server, in-place or windowed editing, and for linked objects the link path, whether it is up to date and an update.
use_for: refresh linked spreadsheet tables in a price list before export
list which OLE objects a client file contains and what program serves them
find broken or outdated links before sending a file out
avoid: final artwork: OLE objects depend on the server program; convert them to curves or place a PDF/image for print (unverified)
cards.how: Coclass whose members are on IVGOLE. Reached as Shape.OLE on shapes of type cdrOLEObjectShape; created with Layer.CreateOLEObject or Layer.CreateOLEObjectFromFile.

key_members.name: LinkPath
key_members.use: file a linked object points to

gotchas: Shape.OLE only applies to OLE shapes; check Shape.Type = cdrOLEObjectShape first
UpdateLink and the edit methods start the server program (e.g. the spreadsheet app), which must be installed (unverified)
Edit / Open leave the object in an editing state; call Deactivate before continuing (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActivePage.Shapes
  If s.Type = cdrOLEObjectShape Then
    If s.OLE.Type = cdrOLELinked Then
      If Not s.OLE.IsLinkUpToDate Then s.OLE.UpdateLink
    End If
  End If
Next s

review.changes: example: IsLinkUpToDate is only read for linked objects (VBA And evaluates both sides); server-program gotcha marked unverified

cards.name: OnScreenCurve
cards.summary: The OnScreenCurve class: a temporary XOR-drawn preview curve shown on top of the document (not part of it), with a pen and brush, set from a curve, a line, a rectangle, a circle or a list of points; custom tools use it for rubber-band previews.
use_for: rubber-band preview of a shape while a custom tool drags
highlight an area or path on screen without changing the document
avoid: anything that must be saved or printed: create real shapes on a layer
cards.how: Coclass whose members are on IVGOnScreenCurve. Created with Application.CreateOnScreenCurve, typically inside a custom IVGToolState; set its geometry, then Show / Hide.

key_members.name: SetPen
key_members.use: outline colour (RGB long), width in pixels, dash style

gotchas: colours are RGB longs (e.g. VBA RGB(255, 0, 0)), not Color objects
it is XOR-drawn, so the colour on screen depends on what is underneath
it disappears when the object is released or hidden; nothing is added to the document (unverified)
SetPen width is in screen pixels (WidthInPixels); that the geometry coordinates are document coordinates is (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim oc As OnScreenCurve
Set oc = CreateOnScreenCurve
oc.SetPen RGB(255, 0, 0), 2, cdrOnScreenCurvePenDash
oc.SetNoBrush
oc.SetRectangle 0, 0, 100, 50
oc.Show

review.changes: gotchas: document-coordinate and release behaviour claims marked unverified (harvest only fixes the pen width in pixels)

cards.name: OnScreenHandle
cards.summary: The OnScreenHandle class: a temporary XOR-drawn handle (a grab handle) shown on top of the document at a position, with a colour and hot-tracking, so a custom tool can offer draggable control points.
use_for: draggable control points in a custom editing tool
show where a script will place something before committing
avoid: permanent markers: create real shapes on a layer
cards.how: Coclass whose members are on IVGOnScreenHandle. Created with Application.CreateOnScreenHandle inside a custom tool; position it, Show it, and in OnMouseMove call UpdateHotTracking / IsOnHandle with the mouse position.

key_members.name: UpdateHotTracking
key_members.use: update the hover state from the mouse position

key_members.name: IsHotTracked
key_members.use: is the mouse over it now

key_members.name: IsOnHandle
key_members.use: are given coordinates on the handle

gotchas: the colour is an RGB long, not a Color object
UpdateHotTracking and IsOnHandle take the mouse position in document coordinates (the tool's pt) (unverified)
only meaningful while a custom tool state is running (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim h As OnScreenHandle
Set h = CreateOnScreenHandle
h.SetHandleColor RGB(0, 120, 255)
h.SetPosition ActiveShape.CenterX, ActiveShape.CenterY
h.Show

review.changes: summary: dropped the invented "small grab square" shape

cards.name: OnScreenText
cards.summary: The OnScreenText class: a temporary XOR-drawn text label shown on top of the document (not part of it), with colour, position, alignment and a pixel offset, so a custom tool can display live readouts such as distances or angles next to the cursor.
use_for: live distance or angle readout beside the cursor in a custom measuring tool
label a preview while a custom tool drags
avoid: text that must end up in the design: create artistic text on a layer
cards.how: Coclass whose members are on IVGOnScreenText. Created with Application.CreateOnScreenText, usually inside a custom tool; set text and position, then Show / Hide.

key_members.name: SetTextAndPosition
key_members.use: text, x, y and optional alignment / reference

gotchas: the colour is an RGB long, not a Color object
SetPixelOffset is in screen pixels, which keeps the label clear of the cursor at any zoom; that the x / y position is in document coordinates is (unverified)
XOR drawing makes the label hard to read over busy artwork (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim t As OnScreenText
Set t = CreateOnScreenText
t.SetTextColor RGB(255, 0, 0)
t.SetTextAndPosition "120.5 mm", ActiveShape.CenterX, ActiveShape.CenterY, cdrCenterOnScreenText
t.SetPixelOffset 12, -12
t.Show

review.changes: gotchas: document-coordinate claim for the position marked unverified
